bullets.title: NVDA: Beat-and-raise expected Wednesday; 15%+ AI server price hikes confirmed; $6B Poolside deal; Perplexity investment at $30B+
bullets.body: Consensus expects ~$92-97B Q2 revenue (JPM $91.8B; KeyBanc $97.8B, +7% beat); options market pricing 4.6% 1-day move. Multiple sell-side sources (UBS, Jefferies, MS) project beat-and-raise with Rubin ramp accelerating. Separately, Nvidia confirmed price hikes of 15%+ on AI servers (Blackwell/Grace Rubin) effective early 2027, tied to surging memory costs. Nvidia also struck a $6B deal with Poolside for open-weight model development and is reportedly in talks to invest billions in Perplexity at $30B+ valuation. NVDA remains >3std long crowded heading into print per UBS; hedge funds broadly de-grossed AI/momentum last week.

bullets.title: AVGO: UBS trims FY27 AI revenue by $5B to $130B, cuts PT to $470; $100B financing vehicle in motion
bullets.body: UBS lowers AVGO FY27 AI revenue estimate to $130B from $135B on conservative TPU shipment assumptions (now 6.4M units vs. prior). FQ3 AI revenue guided at $16B (Anthropic TPU ~$2.5B), ramping to $21-22B in FQ4. AVGO arranging ~$100B financing package ($60-70B senior + ~$30B junior debt) to deploy ~2GW AI infrastructure with Blackstone and Apollo participating. Google remains 'plan of record' for AVGO despite MediaTek COT efforts. Both UBS and Jefferies flag potential FY28 AI revenue step-up toward $200B range.

bullets.title: MRVL: Beat-and-raise expected Thursday; Google deal worth up to $120B through 2031
bullets.body: Consensus $2.72B revenue (+35% YoY), EPS $0.93. MS models 35% Q/Q data center growth in July, 22% in October; AI growing 60% FY27, 70% FY28. Jefferies projects $2.8B revenue (+16% Q/Q) and October guidance of $3.1B. Custom ASIC strategy evolving with MSFT Maia and Google XPU attach; Jensen Huang claimed Marvell could become a $1T company. MS flags MRVL trades at 2x+ multiple of AVGO/NVDA—meaningful estimate upside needed, not multiple expansion.

bullets.title: SNOW: JPM previews Q2 beat; expects +36% Platform Revenue vs +30.5% Street on Cortex checks
bullets.body: JPM forecasts SNOW Q2 Platform Revenue +36% YoY (vs. Street +30.5%) on strong Cortex Code channel checks; Q3 guidance acceleration to +31-32% seen as minimum for bulls to remain satisfied. FY27 Platform Revenue guide expected near $5.975B vs. Street $5.7B. Key risk: Databricks growing +80% YoY with $5B raise at $190B valuation, raising market-share concerns. Data Dispatch confirms Snowflake launched dynamic model routing in Cortex AI Gateway with LLM-vendor neutrality.

bullets.title: META: Down 7% last week as $1T teen-safety trial begins; CEO/Mosseri expected to testify
bullets.body: JPM flags META facing federal teen-safety trial in Northern California with state AG coalition seeking up to $1.4T; 6-8 week bench trial with Zuckerberg and Mosseri testifying. JPM lowered estimates and sees near-term overhang; Hedgeye Risk Range rated Bearish (buy $524, sell $582). One X user draws tobacco-litigation parallel as long-term tail risk. Meta also attracting hedge funds on catalysts: Watermelon launch, Meta Connect, possible neocloud deal.

bullets.title: CLS upgraded to Buy by UBS and CLS; supply-chain checks show AI demand materially underestimated
bullets.body: UBS and CLS both upgrade Celestica to Buy with $430 PT; supply-chain checks suggest market is materially underestimating AI infrastructure demand scale and duration. UBS sees CLS supporting ~50% EPS CAGR through 2028 vs. valuation implying only ~11% long-term growth. CLS -12.4% last week on TSX (equity offering dilution concerns) but analysts say AI demand runway is intact.

bullets.title: BABA: $10.2B equity placement at 3.6% discount; AI cloud revenue to accelerate >50% YoY next quarter
bullets.body: Alibaba placed 710M shares at HK$112.70 (3.6% discount), raising HK$80B ($10.2B)—its largest follow-on since 2019 listing—entirely earmarked for full-stack AI capabilities. Stock fell 8-10% in Hong Kong. Jefferies (Buy, $190 PT) and Citi maintain bullish stance: cloud ARR growth targeting USD4.5B by year-end; 3-year capex payback shortening with margin improvement. Qwen is world's most popular LLM family; management targets $100B external cloud revenue in 5 years.

bullets.title: PSP/data center power: MS targets Oct 2026 signing window; WULF, HUT, CIFR, RIOT top picks
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's Byrd sees power urgency driving AI customers to sign PSP deals by October to energize capacity before year-end 2027. Powered-shell lease rates rose from $1.80/watt to $2.30-2.40/watt. Key calls: WULF $62.50 PT (300% upside, Muskie 800MW could add ~$14.75/share); HUT $273 PT (238% upside, 1GW signed + River Bend 770MW expansion); CIFR could sign 700-1,000 gross MW by Oct; MARA Underweight. RIOT Corsicana 1,000MW site outside ERCOT Batch, potential full lease by Sept-end.

bullets.title: CRWV: 22V and Wolfe recommend upside calls at YTD lows; compute pricing inflection supports estimate revisions
bullets.body: CRWV down 25% from recent highs with Jan 120 calls at YTD lows (below 120-day realized vol). 22V argues consensus estimates are too conservative given compute contract price ramp ($10-12M/MW-yr to $25-50M/MW-yr) and improving financing structures. Agentic workloads surpassed human token usage (7.3T 7-day average); H100/Blackwell spot pricing hit new highs. Recommended trade: Buy Jan 120 calls at $9.20 (shares ~$87.85). Lower bond vol into Jackson Hole seen as additional catalyst.

bullets.title: RDDT: Down 14% last week; ChatGPT citation share collapsed from ~4% to <1%; crowded short
bullets.body: JPM flags Reddit as crowded short despite S&P 500 entry; PromptWatch data shows Reddit citations in ChatGPT dropped from ~4% to below 1% recently, negative for DAU trends and LLM licensing revenue. Google AI Overviews and OpenAI negotiations also creating headwinds. Hedgeye moved RDDT to Active Short in communications position monitor.

bullets.title: SPOT: Upgraded to safer haven; +4% last week; $1.5B buyback increase; WMG/SONY deal catalysts
bullets.body: SPOT and NFLX both outperformed as subscription-based safer havens per JPM. SPOT increased buyback authorization by $1.5B to ~$2.2B. Wolfe notes SPOT remains most crowded long in Media; catalyst path includes WMG/SONY music deals, AI tier reveal. JPM lowers NFLX estimates on higher content costs but expects ~165bps/year op margin expansion in 2027-28.

bullets.title: CSCO: MS maintains Overweight; campus refresh in very early innings (~7% refreshed); security approaching double-digit growth
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley calls CSCO 'early in a more durable growth cycle.' Campus Catalyst 4K/6K refresh cycle only ~7% complete; Cat 4K reaches EOL by end-2026. Scale-across has 3 P200 design wins with broader deployment ahead in 1H27. Gross margins baseline ~64%; security approaching double-digit growth exiting FY26.

bullets.title: LITE: MS sees strong demand signals across CPO, NPO, OCS; deal announcements potential in coming months
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley Asia conference recap: NPO opportunity as compelling as CPO with deal announcement potential imminent. Lead customer upsizing OCS orders; both NPO and CPO expected to deliver above-corporate-average margins. Current demand split ~90% EML / ~10% CW shifting to ~80/20%. LTAs protect UHP and pump laser pricing.

bullets.title: PSKY/WBD: California AG cancels Paramount settlement talks citing bad faith; forced cable channel sales likely
bullets.body: California AG Rob Bonta accused Paramount of leaking and misrepresenting settlement discussions, canceling the Aug 24 preliminary meeting. AG expected to demand Paramount and Warner Bros. sell some cable channels and keep movie studios separate post-merger. PSKY +0.8% and WBD +1.1% in premarket despite the news.

bullets.title: MDB: UBS maintains Neutral at $460 PT; no AI acceleration evident; operational database market competitive
bullets.body: Customer checks show stable spending with no material AI-driven lift. UBS notes rivals (Postgres, AWS, MSFT, Redis) narrowing gaps vs. MDB. Valuation at 9x/49x CY27 revs/FCF 'reasonable but full' for 20-25% growth profile. UBS raises PT from $350 to $460 on sector re-rating but prefers to wait for acceleration evidence.

bullets.title: RBLX: Platform CCUs down 20% YoY; RFY algo update planned late Aug/Sep; back-to-school drag ahead
bullets.body: JPM weekly tracker: Peak Platform CCUs -1% W/W to 20.9M, -20% YoY. New mini-hit 'Steal an Egg' at 2.2M peak CCUs. RFY algo update expected late Aug/early Sep to better balance LTV vs. new-to-platform monetization. Hedgeye moved RBLX metaverse tracker to -26.5% YoY with 3Q26 tracking -31.1%. Back-to-school seasonality likely weighs further in coming weeks.

bullets.title: WSM/RH: Citi retail review; WSM market expects +6-7% 2Q SSS; RH -16% last week
bullets.body: Citi covers WSM into earnings (before open Wed): market expects +6-7% 2Q SSS with modest year guide raise. RH declined 16% last week as part of retail sector weakness. Retail coverage fell -2.6% last week vs. S&P -1.4%. Hedgeye keeps WSM as top idea short on tariff lapping pressure through 2H (West Elm +8.5% 1Q comp creates deceleration setup).

bullets.title: UBER: €825M GDPR fine from Dutch authorities; 2nd-largest GDPR penalty on record
bullets.body: Dutch authorities fined Uber €825M ($963M) for using automated systems to suspend driver accounts improperly, marking the second-largest GDPR penalty on record. No analyst commentary yet on earnings impact, though this represents a meaningful one-time charge.

bullets.title: AAOI: $600M equity distribution agreement triggers -12.7% premarket drop; dilution debate intensifies
bullets.body: StreetAccount reports AAOI declined 12.7% in premarket after announcing a $600M equity distribution agreement via Raymond James and Needham. Multiple accounts flagged this as continuing dilution (19% in 2026) that undermines the investment case despite a positive operating outlook. Rosenblatt analyst laid out plans to reduce equity reliance in future periods.

bullets.title: VST/TLN: Mizuho initiates both at Outperform on AI/DC power demand; VST FCF yield to reach ~13% by 2028
bullets.body: Mizuho initiates Vistra (VST) at Outperform with $169 PT on structural US electricity demand growth from AI; FCF yield expanding 8% (2025) to ~13% by 2028. Initiates Talen Energy (TLN) at Outperform with $405 PT; PJM capacity auction tightened from $29/MW-day to ~$330/MW-day; Susquehanna nuclear plant provides scarce generation with Amazon PPA; Cornerstone adds 2.6GW gas capacity.
